data.description: Once per round, as a free action, an ascomoid can release a jet of deadly spores in a 30-foot line. Upon impacting a solid surface, such as a wall or creature, the jet billows out into a cloud of spores, that fills a 10-foot-radius area. This cloud lasts for 1 round before dispersing. Any creature in the cloud inhales ascomoid poison (Save Fortitude DC %1, Frequency 1 round (7), Effect 1 Con damage, Cure 1 save). Even if the save succeeds, creatures inside the cloud are nauseated as long as they remain in the cloud. Ascomoids are immune to ascomoid spores.
